svg.title: Example Model Routing Card
svg.desc: A filled example of a routing card with task type, first choice, fallback, escalation trigger, human gate and data rule.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fill your own after you test. The point is that every row answers: first choice, fallback, when to climb, who decides.
